grammar.title: Making someone do something with 让
grammar.explanation: 让 (ràng) means to let, ask, or make someone do something. Put the person who receives the request right after 让, then say what they should do. It works like the English pattern "have/let someone do something".

grammar.title: Conditionals with 如果...就
grammar.pattern: 如果 + condition, (主语) 就 + result
grammar.explanation: 如果 (rúguǒ) introduces a condition, like English "if". The result clause adds 就 (jiù) right before the verb to mean "then". In casual speech 如果 can be dropped, but 就 usually stays.

sentences.en: Mom told me to come home early.
The teacher had us write characters.

sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng wǒ kàn tā de shǒujī.
sentences.en: He let me look at his phone.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ ràng wǒ xiǎng yi xiǎng.

sentences.zh: 如果你忙，我就不打电话了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ máng, wǒ jiù bù dǎ diànhuà le.
sentences.en: If you're busy, then I won't call.

sentences.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù le.
sentences.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

sentences.zh: 如果你不知道，就问老师。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù zhīdào, jiù wèn lǎoshī.
sentences.en: If you don't know, ask the teacher.

sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xǐhuan, jiù mǎi ba.
sentences.en: If you like it, then buy it.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo ràng tā ná zǒu le.
sentences.en: My wallet was taken away by him.

sentences.zh: 这个房间坐得下十个人。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān zuò de xià shí gè rén.
sentences.en: This room can seat ten people.
